messages.text: The incident is the unique index todos_client_key firing on the second of two POST /api/todos that arrived together with the same clientKey. flags.ts points at store.ts: with double-submit on, insert() selects by the key and then inserts, so two requests that both find nothing both insert, and the second one hits the index and becomes a 500 through the error handler. The existing test for the double submit runs with no flags, so it never saw this path. The reproduction builds the app with bugs: new Set(["double-submit"]), sends the two requests with Promise.all and asserts one 201 and one 200 with the same id, nothing reported; a second test checks that a later repeat of the key is still answered with the existing to-do.

messages.text: The cause is the check-then-insert branch behind the flag. The fix deletes it, so the one statement with ON CONFLICT ... DO NOTHING RETURNING followed by one select is the only path; the database decides who was first. The bugs parameter had no other reader, so it goes from the implementation and the Store interface, and the route in app.ts stops passing it. The flag's entry in flags.ts gets fixedBy: "inc-aef82d2a" so SAMPLE_BUGS=double-submit is still accepted and now changes nothing. The symptom test in api.test.ts steps aside once the entry is marked, so no test is touched. No mutex, no retry, no debounce in the front.
